annotations.title: What a GLP-1 should cost: the fair cash price

description: The GLP Chart fair cash price, published monthly: for each GLP-1 drug, form and dose (Wegovy pill and pen, Ozempic, Zepbound vials and pens, Mounjaro, Foundayo, compounded semaglutide and compounded tirzepatide), what the middle seller charges each month in cash with fees included, plus the cheapest and highest verified sellers. Where fewer than three sellers publish a price, it lists the sellers instead of a fair price.

dose.description: Optional dose filter, e.g. "5 mg" or "2.5mg".

drug.description: Optional. A drug, a drug and form, or a molecule: "Wegovy", "Wegovy pill", "Zepbound vial", "Ozempic", "Foundayo", "compounded semaglutide", "tirzepatide". Omit for every drug at the dose people stay on.
